definitions.explanation: A temperature that is low, whether of the air, an object, or a process. The antonym of {高温|こうおん} (high temperature). Common in weather, food storage, cooking, and scientific contexts.

examples.japanese: {低温|ていおん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{材料|ざいりょう}→材料：02831_zairyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{低温|ていおん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{弱|よわ}い→弱い：00825_yowai⟧。
examples.english: This material is vulnerable to low temperatures.

examples.japanese: {低温|ていおん}⟦{調理|ちょうり}→調理：07156_chouri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{柔|やわ}らかく→柔らかい：01096_yawarakai⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}げる→仕上げる：04664_shiageru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}いている→向く：02304_muku⟧。
examples.english: Low-temperature cooking is well suited to making meat tender.

notes:
The antonym of ⟦{高温|こうおん}→高温：14705_kouon⟧ (high temperature). Frequent in food storage, scientific, and weather contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {低温|ていおん}⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧: low-temperature storage
- {低温|ていおん}⟦{調理|ちょうり}→調理：07156_chouri⟧: low-temperature (sous-vide) cooking
- {低温|ていおん}⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧: caution against low temperatures

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{高温|こうおん}→高温：14705_kouon⟧: high temperature — the direct antonym
- ⟦{冷|つめ}たい→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧: cold — an adjective describing things that feel cold to the touch
